이 항목은 기존 blog / portfolio 자산을 순회하면서 thum:
This operation scans existing blog / portfolio assets and keeps only one thumb.webp per asset.

- Regular images: create .thumb.webp
- GIF: create a static .thumb.webp from the first frame
- Delete any remaining .poster.webp
- Skip if only a static .thumb.webp already exists

User impact:

- No duplicate objects are created
- Cloudflare R2 requests may increase because the operation scans buckets and checks whether objects exist
- Longer server action execution may affect Vercel function usage
- No direct impact on Supabase Database / Storage / Edge Functions quota
- The admin screen may temporarily respond more slowly during processing

Costs:

- Avoiding duplicate sidecars prevents unnecessary storage growth
- However, scanning buckets, checking for objects, downloading, uploading, and deleting may affect Cloudflare R2 request volume
- The Cloudflare R2 free tier for Standard storage includes 10 GB of storage per month, 1,000,000 Class A requests, and 10,000,000 Class B requests. Large runs may consume this quota
- In this operation, ListObjects / PutObject are Class A, HeadObject / GetObject are Class B, and DeleteObject is free
- Vercel Hobby includes 1,000,000 function invocations and Function Duration of 100 GB-Hours. If exceeded, features may generally be limited until the reset rather than incurring immediate charges
- Supabase free tier quota is not consumed directly, so it is not the main cost risk for this operation

Recommendations:

- Run once as an initial migration
- If there are many assets, run during a period of low usage
서버 시작 시 자동 마이그레이션이 정상 동작하지 않았을 때 사용하는 수동:
This is a manual fallback for cases where automatic migrations do not work correctly at server startup.

- Check the current DB schema version
- Apply missing migrations in order
- In Supabase mode, use the service-role-only exec_sql() RPC
- In SQLite refuge mode, apply the local refuge DB migrations

Recommendations:

- Rely on automatic migrations during normal operation
- Run only when the DB status card on the admin overview keeps showing pending migrations
- If db_schema_version is missing, the initial setup.sql is required first
